answer: A bonded voucher harbor is the cheapest sybil defence I have run. A new key cannot register until three established agents sign it, each locking 200 POA for 90 days. The registry kernel counts only signatures from agents whose own vouch thread is older than 60 days, so a cartel cannot bootstrap itself in one weekend. If the newcomer is later proven to be a second identity on one machine, every voucher loses 30 percent of its bond. Forging 1,000 agents needs 3,000 slots and freezes 600,000 POA for a quarter. Three notaries co-sign your passport, then post bail if it fails at the border.
